from.name: Trip Attack
from.tooltip: Weapon attack, weapon range: weapon damage + 1d8; Str save (target is Prone). With more than one attack, these bonuses and riders apply until the first hit; the rest are plain hits

from.name: Pushing Attack
from.tooltip: Weapon attack, weapon range: weapon damage + 1d8; Str save (pushes target 2 tiles away). With more than one attack, these bonuses and riders apply until the first hit; the rest are plain hits

from.name: Menacing Attack
from.tooltip: Weapon attack, weapon range: weapon damage + 1d8; Wis save (target is Frightened for 1 round). With more than one attack, these bonuses and riders apply until the first hit; the rest are plain hits

from.name: Precision Attack
from.tooltip: Weapon attack, weapon range: weapon damage. With more than one attack, these bonuses and riders apply until the first hit; the rest are plain hits — Your superiority die steadies the blow: +4 to hit.

from.name: Goading Attack
from.tooltip: Weapon attack, weapon range: weapon damage + 1d8; Wis save (taunts target for 1 round). With more than one attack, these bonuses and riders apply until the first hit; the rest are plain hits

from.name: Rally
from.tooltip: 6 tiles: target gains 1d8 + CHA modifier temporary HP

from.name: Feint
from.tooltip: Self: you get +4 weapon damage and have advantage on your attack rolls until the end of your turn — A feint opens your foe up: advantage and +4 damage on your attacks this turn.
